nodes.label: MLX
nodes.description: Apple Silicon ML Framework. Used for heavy compute pipelines: transformers, diffusion backbones, LLM text encoders. Provides zero-copy Unified Memory semantics.

nodes.label: PyTorch
nodes.description: Deep learning framework used with MPS backend for native PyTorch model compatibility.

nodes.label: Metal Performance Shaders (MPS)
nodes.description: Apple GPU acceleration backend for PyTorch. Used when MLX conversion is not practical.

nodes.label: ComfyUI
nodes.description: Node-based GUI for running diffusion models. ASDX nodes extend ComfyUI via custom node architecture.

nodes.label: Apple Silicon
nodes.description: Apple M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 chips (Pro, Max, Ultra). Feature Unified Memory Architecture sharing RAM between CPU, GPU, and NPU.

nodes.label: FLUX Transformer
nodes.description: FLUX.1 diffusion transformer model. Runs natively in MLX in ASDX (pure MLX, no C++ core).

nodes.label: FluxConfig
nodes.description: @dataclass(frozen=True) configuration object. Most connected node in knowledge graph - bridges 7 of 18 communities: Model Loader, Dtype, Transformer Blocks, FluxTransformer Core, Config, RoPE, Sampler.

nodes.label: SeaCache
nodes.description: Skip computation when previous step output is similar enough. Adaptive threshold interpolation on accumulated L1 norm.

nodes.label: TeaCache
nodes.description: Output-level caching with adaptive threshold interpolation. Step skipping acceleration.

nodes.label: Kontext
nodes.description: KV cache system. Stores K/V per transformer layer with configurable token count. Reference image tokens cached and injected into transformer attention layers.

nodes.label: LoRA
nodes.description: Low-Rank Adaptation for model customization. Supports standard A/B matrices and ComfyUI diff format with per-LoRA alpha scaling. Up to 5 LoRAs stacked simultaneously.

nodes.label: ControlNet Union
nodes.description: ControlNet supporting 8 control types: pose, depth, soft_edge, line_canny, normal, segment, tile, repaint.

nodes.label: IP-Adapter
nodes.description: Cross-attention injection using CLIP-Vision reference encoding. Uses CLIP-Vision-H encoder with projection weights.

nodes.label: Unified Memory
nodes.description: Apple Silicon architecture sharing RAM between CPU, GPU, NPU. Enables zero-copy between MLX and PyTorch MPS.

nodes.label: Zero-Copy
nodes.description: MLX and PyTorch MPS share same physical memory. mx.array(np_array) creates a view not a copy when possible.

nodes.label: float16
nodes.description: Native on Apple Silicon, best performance default. MLX handles float16 stably. torch.float16 on MPS can cause NaNs in LayerNorm/VAE.

nodes.label: bfloat16
nodes.description: Better numerical stability for sensitive ops. Supported natively by both MLX and PyTorch MPS.

nodes.label: float32
nodes.description: Fallback precision for PyTorch MPS when float16 causes NaNs. Default for ComfyUI IMAGE tensors.

nodes.label: Tensor Format
nodes.description: ComfyUI Images: [B, H, W, C] float32 in range [0.0, 1.0]. PyTorch/MLX convolutions need [B, C, H, W].

nodes.label: MLX Lazy Evaluation
nodes.description: MLX computations not executed until mx.eval() is called. Strategic eval points at bridge boundaries.

nodes.label: Cache Management
nodes.description: mx.clear_cache() after sampling. mx.eval() / mx.synchronize() at bridge points. torch.mps.empty_cache() for PyTorch MPS.

nodes.label: T5-XXL
nodes.description: T5-XXL text encoder. When t5xxl parameter is provided, ASDX_CLIPTextEncode runs in FLUX mode (separate clip_l + t5xxl + guidance).

nodes.label: CLIP-L
nodes.description: CLIP-L text encoder. Loaded with Dual CLIP Loader alongside T5-XXL.

nodes.label: CLIP-Vision-H
nodes.description: CLIP-Vision-H encoder for IP-Adapter reference image encoding.

nodes.label: VAE
nodes.description: Variational Autoencoder for image encoding/decoding. MLX-native VAE encode and decode nodes.

nodes.label: 16-channel Latent
nodes.description: FLUX latent space format with 16 channels.

nodes.label: Euler Sampler
nodes.description: Euler denoising sampler implemented in pure MLX.

nodes.label: RoPE
nodes.description: Rotary Positional Embeddings. Precomputed once, reused across steps for inference speed.

nodes.label: Text Projection (txt_in)
nodes.description: txt_in(emb) computed once, reused across steps for inference speed.

nodes.label: ComfyUI Node Structure
nodes.description: Standard ComfyUI node conventions: INPUT_TYPES (class method), RETURN_TYPES, RETURN_NAMES, FUNCTION (string), CATEGORY. Module-level NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS and NODE_DISPLAY_NAME_MAPPINGS.

nodes.label: Python Style Guide
nodes.description: Python 3.10+, fully type-annotated, PEP8 compliant.

nodes.label: PyTorch-MLX Bridge
nodes.description: Interoperability layer: PyTorch tensors to MLX arrays via mx.array(torch_tensor.cpu().numpy()), MLX arrays to PyTorch via torch.from_numpy(np.array(mlx_arr)).to('mps').

nodes.label: Device Detection
nodes.description: Dynamic detection: torch.backends.mps.is_available() for MPS, import mlx.core as mx for MLX, fallback to CPU.

nodes.label: Pipeline Architecture
nodes.description: CLIP/T5 conditioning and 16-channel latent input feed into ASDX_MLXSampler (FluxTransformer, SeaCache/TeaCache, Kontext, LoRA, ControlNet, IP-Adapter), output to ASDX_VAEDecode, producing [B,H,W,C] IMAGE tensor.

nodes.label: Project Canon System
nodes.description: Settled engineering decisions stored at .claude/canon.md. Records appended, never rewritten. Managed with Claudoscope.

nodes.label: Canon Protocol
nodes.description: Rules for canon records: format (title + metadata line + body), kinds (choice/constraint/convention/gotcha), status (canon/non-canon superseded), reading protocol (search before planning), writing protocol (append only, user approval).

nodes.label: Record Kinds
nodes.description: Canon record types: choice, constraint, convention, gotcha.

nodes.label: Record Status
nodes.description: Canon record statuses: canon (active), non-canon superseded by (replaced by newer record).

nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.description: Knowledge graph extraction pipeline. Previous run: 426 nodes, 649 edges, 18 communities. Output: graph.html (202 Ko), graph.json (381 Ko).

nodes.description: Integrated LoRA, TeaCache, Kontext, ControlNet Union, IP-Adapter. Updated transformer for kontext_kv. All 14 Python files pass py_compile. 2 commits on master.

nodes.description: Fused ASDX_CLIPTextEncodeFlux + ASDX_CLIPTextEncode into single autodetecting node. Reduction of -30 lines. Commit e835a61.

nodes.description: Fixed ASDX_DiffusionLoader from broken placeholder to real loader using native.load_transformer. Added ASDX_CheckpointLoader. Ran full graphify analysis.

nodes.label: FLUX.2 / Klein
nodes.description: Next-gen FLUX model. Partial support (kontext added), full model not yet implemented.

nodes.label: Git Repository
nodes.description: Git repo with commits on master branch. Commits: 92f77a4 (graphify update), eb4192a (CLIP canon), e835a61 (CLIP unification), 1ac46e5 (CLIP types), 0d265fd (CLIP Loader).

nodes.label: Installation
nodes.description: Symlink apple_silicon_nodes into ComfyUI/custom_nodes. Install deps: pip install mlx numpy safetensors. Restart ComfyUI.

nodes.label: Memory Tracking
nodes.description: Peak memory tracking built into every node for debugging OOM. Memory Profiler node shows real-time MLX/MPS stats.

nodes.label: ControlNet Control Types
nodes.description: 8 control types supported: pose, depth, soft_edge, line_canny, normal, segment, tile, repaint.

nodes.label: LoRA Formats
nodes.description: Two supported formats: standard A/B matrices and ComfyUI diff format. Per-LoRA alpha scaling.

nodes.label: LoRA Schedules
nodes.description: Per-step strength modulation: linear, cosine, ease-in-out.

nodes.label: Precomputed RoPE
nodes.description: Positional embeddings computed once, reused across steps.

nodes.label: 14 Isolated Nodes
nodes.description: 14 isolated nodes identified in graphify analysis: T5-XXL, LoRA Schedule, Diffusion sampler Euler - possible documentation gaps.
